# Setup

## Load packages
```{r}
# Define packages to load
pkgs <- c(
  "Seurat", 
  "SeuratObject", 
  "dplyr", 
  "tidyr", 
  "Matrix", 
  "ggplot2", 
  "ggpubr",
  "remotes", 
  "here", 
  "renv", 
  "patchwork", 
  "gridExtra",
  "rstudioapi", 
  "ggeffects", 
  "DHARMa", 
  "fields",
  "GEOquery", 
  "org.Hs.eg.db", 
  "AnnotationDbi",
  "msigdbr", 
  "clusterProfiler", 
  "lme4",
  "lmerTest", 
  "emmeans"
)

#Load packages (will return TRUE if loaded and FALSE if failed)
sapply(pkgs,
  function(x) suppressWarnings(
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(
      require(x, character.only = TRUE)
    )
  )
)
```

## Set seed to improve reproducibility

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

## Create file structure

```{r}
dirs <- c(
  "data/raw",
  "data/processed",
  "results/objects",
  "results/figures"
)

lapply(
  dirs,
  \(d) dir.create(here(d),
                  recursive = TRUE,
                  showWarnings = FALSE)
)
```

# Load data and create Seurat object (use Terminal!)

## Download files/unzip

```{r}
#Takes ~5-10min to load data
system(
  paste(
    "curl -L",
    "https://cells.ucsc.edu/ms/rawMatrix.zip",
    "-o",
    shQuote(here("data", "raw", "rawMatrix.zip"))
  )
)

unzip(
  here("data", "raw", "rawMatrix.zip"),
  exdir = here("data", "raw")
)

list.files(
  here("data", "raw"),
  recursive = TRUE
)
```

## Create 10X object

```{r}
mat <- readMM(here("data", "raw", "matrix.mtx"))
dim(mat)
```

```{r}
total_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mat)

summary(total_counts)
hist(total_counts, breaks = 100, main = "UMI per barcode")
```

```{r}
data <- Read10X(data.dir = here("data", "raw", "rawMatrix"))
data1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data, project = "MS3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200) #filter out low expressing cells and genes
```

## add metadata

```{r}
# define metadata and add $cell and $sample slots
metadata <- read.delim(file = here("data", "raw", "rawMatrix", "meta.txt"))
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$cell
data1@meta.data$sample <- gsub("^[ACGT]+-[0-9]+_", "", rownames(data1@meta.data))

# check that sample and cell ids match in data and metadata
unique(data1@meta.data$sample)
unique(metadata$sample)
unique(metadata$diagnosis)
all(rownames(data1@meta.data) == metadata$cell) #likely FALSE because some cells were filtered out

# add metadata to object
data1 <- AddMetaData(data1, metadata = metadata)
```

# Exploratory analysis and QC

## Mitochondrial gene expression and distribution

```{r}
data1[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(data1, pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(
  data1,
  features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
  ncol = 3 
)
```

# Dimensionality reduction

## Filter/normalize data

```{r}
data1 <- subset(data1, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)
data1 <- NormalizeData(data1, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
```

## Define variable genes

```{r}
data1 <- FindVariableFeatures(data1, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) #most variable genes to be used in creating UMAP plots
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(data1)
plot1

#plot top variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(data1), 10)
LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
```

## Scale data and run PCA

```{r}
all.genes <- rownames(data1)
data1<- ScaleData(data1, features = all.genes)
data1 <- RunPCA(data1, features = VariableFeatures(object = data1), npcs = 30)
ElbowPlot(data1) #appears that 1:10 dims is appropriate for our analysis
```

## Cluster cells and dimensionality reduction

```{r}
data1<- FindNeighbors(data1, dims = 1:10)
data1 <- FindClusters(data1, resolution = 0.5) #for purpose of our analysis 0.5 okay
data1 <- RunUMAP(data1, dims = 1:10)
```

## Visualize clusters

```{r}
DP_clus_all <- DimPlot(data1, reduction = "umap")

DP_grp_disease <- DimPlot(data1, reduction = "umap", group.by = "diagnosis", cols = c("Control" = "steelblue", "MS" = "firebrick"), pt.size = 0.5)  + theme_classic() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

DP_splt_disease <- DimPlot(data1, reduction = "umap", split.by = "diagnosis")

DP_grp_individual <- DimPlot(data1, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample")

DP_clus_all
DP_grp_disease
DP_splt_disease
DP_grp_individual
```

# Glycolytic markers in Mg

## Boxplot of TREM2 and BSG (EMMPRIN) expression

```{r}
df <- FetchData(
  object = Cluster8,
  vars = c("TREM2", "BSG", "diagnosis", "sample")
)

df_avg <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("TREM2", "BSG"),
               names_to = "Gene",
               values_to = "Expression") %>%
  group_by(sample, diagnosis, Gene) %>%
  summarize(Expression = mean(Expression), .groups = "drop")

BP_BSG_TREM2_diagnosis_Mg <- ggplot(
  df_avg, aes(x = diagnosis, y = Expression, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "red", "MS" = "blue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average TREM2 & BSG Expression per Individual (Cluster 8)",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Average Expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Adding p-values
pvals <- df_avg %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarize(
    p_value = wilcox.test(Expression ~ diagnosis)$p.value
  )
pvals

BP_BSG_TREM2_diagnosis_Mg_pval <- ggplot(df_avg, aes(x = diagnosis, y = Expression, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "red", "MS" = "blue")) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format", 
    label.y.npc = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Gene Expression per Individual (Cluster 8)",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Average Expression"
  ) +
  # scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  theme_classic()

BP_BSG_TREM2_diagnosis_Mg
BP_BSG_TREM2_diagnosis_Mg_pval
```

# Correlation analysis (BSG ~ glycolysis)

## Load Hallmark gene set

```{r}
gly_hall_genes <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
) |>
  dplyr::filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_GLYCOLYSIS") |>
  dplyr::pull(gene_symbol) |>
  unique()
length(gly_hall_genes)#should be 200 genes long
```

## Add Hallmark score to single cells

```{r}
Cluster8 <- AddModuleScore(
  Cluster8,
  features = list(intersect(gly_hall_genes, rownames(Cluster8))),
  name = "gly_hall"
)
```

## Mixed effects model

```{r}
df_cor <- data.frame(
  BSG = FetchData(Cluster8, "BSG")[,1],
  glycolysis = Cluster8$gly_hall1,
  individual = Cluster8$sample,
  stage = Cluster8$stage
)

#center BSG expression (allows model to be more interpretible and stable)
df_cor$BSG_c <- scale(df_cor$BSG, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

#need to change to factor so that I can reorder with Control as my reference
df_cor$stage <- factor(df_cor$stage) 
df_cor$stage <- relevel(df_cor$stage, ref = "Control")

#Test model: We want to know the correlation between BSG and glycolysis while controlling for the random effects of each individual
#Adding random slope as well (suggesting BSG~glycolysis response varies per individual)
model_mixed <- lmer(glycolysis ~ BSG_c * stage + (1 | individual), data = df_cor) 
summary(model_mixed)
```

## Plot correlation results

```{r}
# Get marginal predictions
pred_stage <- ggpredict(
  model_mixed,
  terms = c("BSG_c", "stage")
)

# Plot
Corr_simple_all <- ggplot(pred_stage,
       aes(x = x, y = predicted,
           color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  labs(
    x = "Centered BSG expression",
    y = "Glycolysis score",
    color = "Stage",
    fill = "Stage"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

Corr_simple_all
```

## Generate stats

```{r}
#Pull Beta/slope and p-value information
slopes <- emtrends(
  model_mixed,
  specs = "stage",
  var = "BSG_c"
)

slopes_df <- as.data.frame(
  summary(slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
)

colnames(slopes_df)

# Create annotation labels
slopes_df$label <- sprintf(
  "Slope = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f], p-value = %.3f",
  slopes_df$BSG_c.trend,
  slopes_df$lower.CL,
  slopes_df$upper.CL,
  slopes_df$p.value
)

# Extract y-position for each stage at max x
y_pos <- pred_stage %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  filter(x == max(x)) %>%
  summarise(y = predicted, .groups = "drop")

# Join y-positions to slopes
slopes_df <- left_join(
  slopes_df,
  y_pos,
  by = c("stage" = "group")
)

# Add annotations to plot
corr_simple_all_labelled <- Corr_simple_all +
  geom_text(
    data = slopes_df,
    aes(
      x = max(pred_stage$x) * 0.9,
      y = y,
      label = label,
      color = stage
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  )
corr_simple_all_labelled
```

## Function for saving figures

```{r}
save_figures <- function(
  plots,
  figure_save_path,
  current_date,
  sizes = NULL,
  default_size = c(6, 5),
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  ext = "jpg",
  envir = parent.frame()
) {

  dir.create(figure_save_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  for (plot_name in plots) {

    # Get plot object by name
    plot_obj <- get(plot_name, envir = envir)

    # determine size
    if (!is.null(sizes) && plot_name %in% names(sizes)) {
      width  <- sizes[[plot_name]][1]
      height <- sizes[[plot_name]][2]
    } else {
      width  <- default_size[1]
      height <- default_size[2]
    }

    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        figure_save_path,
        paste0(current_date, "_", plot_name, ".", ext)
      ),
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = units,
      dpi = dpi
    )
  }
}
```

## Save all figures of interest

```{r}
# list of figures to save
plots_to_save <- c("DP_clus_all", "DP_grp_disease", "DP_splt_disease", "DP_splt_disease_new", "FP_P2RY12", "FP_CSF1R", "FP_CX3CR1", "FP_TMEM119", "DP_Mg_markers", "BP_BSG_TREM2_diagnosis_Mg", "BP_BSG_TREM2_diagnosis_Mg_pval", "Corr_simple_all", "Corr_individual_all", "Corr_individual_facet", "corr_simple_all_labelled")

# specify size here if needs to be different than default
plot_sizes <- list(
  corr_simple_all_labelled   = c(8, 5)
)

#save figures (specify filepath)
save_figures(plots_to_save, plot_sizes, figure_save_path = here("results", "figures"), current_date = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"))
```
